phase_name: Orchestrate and execute the full harvest

objectives.description: Create bootstrap-harvest.sh orchestrator joining the three passes and computing inferred_outcome
Fix manifest generation bug: parse_kv_line picked up interleaved WARN lines before the summary line, corrupting harvest-manifest.json into invalid JSON
Fix attribution script: sidecars_decode_failed counter declared but never incremented/reported
Run the full harvest and produce sessions.jsonl, history-spine.jsonl, harvest-manifest.json
Write dataset/README.md with schema, inferred_outcome formula, honest known-gaps section

approaches_tried.approach: trust the killed prior session's on-disk harvest-manifest.json without re-validating
approaches_tried.reason: jq empty on the inherited manifest.json failed with a parse error at line 10 -- the pre-fix WARN-line-corruption bug was still present in the artifact even though sessions.jsonl/history-spine.jsonl themselves were valid; required re-running the full orchestrator after completing the fix

deviations.reason: The full 3-pass harvest (~171s wall clock) was run three times during this resume: once to regenerate a manifest with the parse_kv_line fix, a second time after discovering and fixing the sidecars_decode_failed reporting gap, and results were cross-checked for convergence between the last two runs (identical counts). This is more re-runs than a single perishable critical-path pass would ideally need, but was necessary because the killed session left a corrupted manifest and an incompletely-wired counter; the corpus read is read-only and idempotent so re-running is safe.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — three harvest runs instead of one, to converge on a fully correct and internally consistent manifest)*
